name: sqlite_hot_mcp_candidates_survive_busy_idle_reopen_and_operational_index_repair
review: The same root-level MCP demand table runs both external and bound self-hosted placement, checks Idle -> Busy -> Idle, retained Worker identity, independent clients and reconstruction. The unbound self-hosted control cannot enter the MCP-update lane. A controlled stale projection must actually hide pending work before operational reconstruction restores it without changing the canonical root. PostgreSQL server mode specifically refuses stale derived indexes without repairing them.
limitation: These are native SQL store/index tests. They do not execute a physical MCP manager, prove process-death recovery, qualify all preparation/cleanup transports, or accept a complete T16/T34 scenario. Actual execution remains separately qualified with its original source identity.
